description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects client-supplied nonempty X-DSCGI-PATH CGI-dispatch headers.
affected_versions: Ivanti Connect Secure: consult linked CNA affected configuration; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects client-supplied nonempty X-DSCGI-PATH CGI-dispatch headers.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate frontends relying on this private dispatch header need a separate trusted policy.
